about: 李录是喜马拉雅资本创始人兼董事长。1997 年创立公司后，一直管理其主要基金；他在哥伦比亚大学同时取得 BA、JD 和 MBA 三个学位。
Li Lu is the founder and chairman of Himalaya Capital. He has managed its principal fund since founding the firm in 1997, after earning BA, JD and MBA degrees simultaneously at Columbia University.
他的投资脉络承接格雷厄姆、巴菲特与芒格：把股票背后的企业研究透，在自己的能力圈里等待好机会，机会真正出现时敢于集中投入。喜马拉雅主要投资亚洲和北美，关注护城河、成长空间与值得信任的管理层。

His approach follows Graham, Buffett and Munger: understand the underlying business, wait patiently within a circle of competence, and commit decisively when an exceptional opportunity appears. Himalaya focuses mainly on Asia and North America, looking for durable moats, growth and trustworthy managers.
深度研究和长期持有，是理解李录的两个关键词。喜马拉雅的一些投资已持有二十年；他也在公开演讲中反复讨论，如何在无法左右的宏观环境里，找到自己能够理解并有所作为的企业。

Deep research and long-term ownership define his approach. Some Himalaya investments have been held for twenty years. His public talks examine how an investor can understand individual businesses while accepting a macro environment beyond their control.
summary: 研究到真正理解，等待到机会足够好，再把资本交给优秀企业和时间。能力圈决定在哪里挥棒，安全边际决定何时挥棒。
Understand the business deeply, wait for an exceptional opportunity, then give the business and compounding time to work. Competence defines where to swing; a margin of safety defines when.

about: Mohnish Pabrai 是 Pabrai Investment Funds 创始人及管理合伙人，也是 Pabrai Wagons Fund 的组合经理。首只 Pabrai 基金于 1999 年启动。
Mohnish Pabrai founded Pabrai Investment Funds and is its managing partner. He also manages the Pabrai Wagons Fund; the first Pabrai fund launched in 1999.
帕布莱最鲜明的两张名片是 Cloning 与 Dhandho：前者是坦然学习巴菲特、芒格等人的有效方法，再做自己的研究；后者是寻找“正面我赢，反面我也输不了多少”的机会，先想清楚会损失什么，再考虑能赚多少。

Pabrai is closely associated with Cloning and Dhandho. Cloning means learning openly from effective methods, then doing independent research. Dhandho seeks asymmetric opportunities: first understand what could be lost, then assess what could be gained.
著作 The Dhandho Investor 将这套思路讲得直白而生动。他通过 Chai with Pabrai 分享访谈与投资思考，也创办 Dakshana Foundation，将教育公益作为投资之外的长期事业。

The Dhandho Investor presents this framework in direct, memorable terms. He shares interviews and investment thinking on Chai with Pabrai and founded Dakshana Foundation as a long-term commitment to educational philanthropy.

about: 段永平是从企业经营走向投资的企业家，曾领导小霸王，后创立步步高。在雪球上，他以“大道无形我有型”分享对生意、管理和投资的理解。

Duan Yongping is an entrepreneur who moved from operating businesses into investing. He led Subor and later founded BBK, and shares his views on business, management and investing on Xueqiu as 大道无形我有型.
“买股票就是买公司”贯穿他的思路：先问生意能否持续赚钱、管理层是否可靠，再问价格是否合适。“不做空、不借钱、不懂不做”，把能力圈和不做什么放在同样重要的位置。

“Buying stocks is buying companies” defines his approach: study a business’s lasting earning power and its managers before assessing price. Avoiding shorting, borrowing and investments outside his understanding puts restraint alongside conviction.

about: 大卫·泰珀于 1993 年创立 Appaloosa。此前于 1978 年取得匹兹堡大学学位，1982 年获得卡内基梅隆 MBA，1985 年加入高盛。
David Tepper founded Appaloosa in 1993. He graduated from Pittsburgh in 1978, earned his Carnegie Mellon MBA in 1982 and joined Goldman Sachs in 1985.
泰珀的投资底色来自信用研究和困境债务。面对被恐慌抛售的资产，他关注的是资产价值、偿付能力与生存概率：市场究竟低估了风险，还是把仍有价值的企业一并抛弃？

Tepper’s investment roots lie in credit analysis and distressed debt. In a sell-off, the questions are asset value, repayment capacity and survival: is risk being underestimated, or is a viable business being discarded with everything else?
他的风格也强调宏观环境与仓位调整。利率、政策和流动性变化会改变投资逻辑；有把握时集中投入，判断改变时重新评估。他同时是 Carolina Panthers 的所有者。

His approach also considers macro conditions and portfolio positioning. Rates, policy and liquidity can change an investment thesis; strong conviction warrants commitment, while changed evidence calls for reassessment. He also owns the Carolina Panthers.
summary: 在恐慌中寻找错价，以信用研究判断企业能否走出困境。
Look for mispricing in market panic; use credit research to assess whether a business can survive its distress.

about: 大卫·韦伯（David Webb，1965–2026）是香港企业管治及小股东权益倡导者，创办 Webb-site.com，2026 年 1 月 13 日去世。
David Webb (1965–2026) founded Webb-site.com and advocated corporate governance and minority-shareholder rights in Hong Kong. He died on 13 January 2026.
韦伯把价值投资与公司治理研究放在一起：寻找被忽视的港股小型企业，也追查关联交易、股权网络和信息披露中的疑点。Webb-site 的文章与数据库，让普通投资者也能沿着公开文件核对上市公司的来龙去脉。

Webb combined value investing with governance research: studying overlooked Hong Kong small companies while tracing related-party transactions, ownership networks and disclosure gaps. Webb-site gave ordinary investors the tools to follow the public evidence themselves.
